info.title: BulkSMS Universal API
info.description: BulkSMS.com provides a JSON REST API for sending and receiving SMS messages, managing message webhooks and blocked numbers, viewing account profile information, transferring credits, and preparing SMS attachment uploads.

post.description: Creates a signed BulkSMS attachment upload URL.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fileExtension.description: File extension for the attachment upload, usually related to the media type.

mediaType.description: Media type of the file to upload, such as application/pdf.

invokeOption.description: Whether BulkSMS invokes the webhook with one message or many messages.

active.description: Whether the webhook should be active after creation.

onWebApp.description: Whether to show the webhook in the BulkSMS web app.
